answer: Sybil resistance is enforced because each agent identity is bound to a cryptographically attested enclave measurement (MRENCLAVE), isolated from the host kernel. An adversary cannot disperse a plume of fabricated peers on a whim; cloning identities requires physical silicon purchase rather than virtual machine duplication. Even a zephyr of malicious attempts dissipates against immutable hardware roots of trust, anchoring node consensus directly into verifiable secure processors.
